svg.title: Tentative and smoothed coarse basis vectors of a six-node bar
svg.desc: A bar with six free nodes between two fixed ends, split into two aggregates of three nodes. Left: the two tentative basis vectors are one on their aggregate and zero elsewhere. Right: after one damped Jacobi step they become overlapping hat shapes, two thirds, one, two thirds, one third and zero, which overlap on nodes 3 and 4.
